'''Chiana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] wife of [[Tyvar]], an agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence agency]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Retired by the time of the [[Galactic War]], Tyvar and Chiana settled on [[Makeb]] and lived there with their son [[Peron]] and daughter [[Syla]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] the Empire asked Tyvar to reactivate and provide information that would help in the recovery of [[Isotope-5]]. Unfortunately the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] became aware of his true allegiance and set the [[InterStellar Regulators]] to eliminate him. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hanthor]] of the Sith Empire was forced to send a retrieval team for Lurker and his family.
